name: train_spec_kennen
description: Dispatch marker for the Kennen specialist (riftlab.yml, request=lab/specs/train_spec_kennen.json, chain=N iterations): a net of its own, started from the general net, trained on its own decisions with Kennen against the jury of loop.SPECIALISTS['kennen'] (piloted by the general net or by that legend's specialist), adopted when it beats its previous version in the Kennen mirror (55% or SPRT) without doing worse against the jury (paired, 3 points). Ladder: lab/learn/specialists/kennen/ladder.json; nets lab/learn/nets/spec_kennen_*.
